Rebuilt the netstandard2.1 plugin closure into Assets/Plugins so Unity can see the new Projectiles namespace.

beforeAfter.before: No projectile was replicated at all. A launch existed only on the machine that fired it; damage, drop-off and detonation position were computed locally by each peer; grenade fuses and projectile expiry were wall-clock floats that fired on different frames on every machine; a headless server threw grenades instantly while clients threw them about 0.6 s later; ActorManager.Explode had no projectile caller; detonated projectiles were held alive 18 s on a headless server for particles nobody could see; ammo bags and medipacks wrote authoritative health and ammo from any peer, allocating a fresh List per pulse; and InputButtons bit 7 was a reserved trap with no producer or consumer.
beforeAfter.after: One S_PROJECTILE_SPAWN carries every launch; clients simulate the flight and re-seat on a re-announce; the server owns every hit, damage number and detonation position and routes them through the phase-05 damage sink and S_EXPLOSION; expiry and grenade fuses are tick-counted from a shared spawn tick; the throw release is a server-scheduled tick derived from one authored constant; deployables resupply only on the server, through the damage sink and the spare-ammo pool, with a caller-owned buffer and zero measured allocation per sweep; a detonated projectile is destroyed on the next server tick; and bit 7 is Reserved7 with the reason recorded. The swept segment is no longer doubled and the arc is timestep-invariant.
